questions.question: If 8 + 2px² - 36x - 27x³ = (2 - 3x)³, then what is the value of p?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x3 = (2 – 3x)³

**Formula used:**

(a – b)³ = a³ – b³ – 3ab(a – b)

**Calculation:**

(2 – 3x)3 

(a – b)3 = a3 – b3 – 3ab(a – b)

(2)³ – (3x)³ – 3 × 2 × 3x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x³ – 18x (2 – 3x)

⇒ 8 – 27x³ – 36x + 54x²

Comparison the coefficient of both the equation, we get

8 + 2px2 – 36x – 27x³ = 8 – 27x3 – 36x + 54x²

⇒ 2px² = 54x²

⇒ 2p = 54

⇒ p = (54/2)

⇒ p = 27

**∴ The required value of p is 27**

questions.question: The area of a square shaped field is 1764 m². The breadth of a rectangular park is (1)/(6)th of the side of the square field and the length is four times its breadth. What is the cost (in Rs.) of levelling the park at Rs. 30 per m²?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a square shaped field = 1764 m²

**Formula used:**

Area of square = (side)²

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

The area of a square shaped field = 1764 m²

Side of square field = √1764 = 42 m

Breadth of rectangle field = (42 × 1/6) = 7 m

Length of rectangle field = (7 × 4) = 28 m

Area of rectangular field = (28 × 7) m² = 196 m²

Cost of leveling the park = Rs. (196 × 30)

⇒ Rs. 5880

**So, the required cost of leveling the park is 5880**

questions.question: If 2x² - 7x + 5 = 0, then what is the value of x³+(125)/(8x³) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2x2 – 7x + 5

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

2x2 – 7x + 5 = 0

⇒ 2x² + 5 = 7x

⇒ x² + 5/2 = 7/2

⇒ x + 5/2x = 7/2

Cube of both side of equation

⇒ (x + 5/2x)³ = (7/2)³

⇒ (x)³ + (5/2x)³ + 3 × x × 5/2x(x + 5/2x) = 343/8

⇒ x³ + 125/8x³ + 15/2 (7/2) = 343/8

⇒ x³ + 125/8x³ + 105/4 = 343/8

⇒ x³ + 125/8x³ = (343/8 – 105/4)

⇒ x³ + 125/8x³ = (343 – 210)/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = 133/8

⇒ x3 + 125/8x3 = 16(5)/(8)

**∴ The required value is 16(5)/(8)**

questions.question: Radha saves x% of her income. If her income increases by 28% and the expenditure increases by 20%, then her savings increase by 40%. What is the value of x ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radha saves x% of her income.

Increase in her income = 28%

Increase in her expenditure = 20%

Increase in her savings = 40%

**Concept used:**

Income = Saving + Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let income of Radha be 100

Saving of Radha = 100 × (x/100) = x

Expenditure of Radha = (100 – x)

Radha salary after increment = 100 × (128/100) = 128

Radha expenditure after increment = (100 – x) × 120/100 

⇒ (100 – x) × 6/5

New saving = 128 – (100 – x) × 6/5 .....(1)

New saving after increment = (x × 140/100)

New saving after increment = 7x/5 .....(2)

From equation (1) and (2)

 128 – (100 – x) × 6/5 = 7x/5

⇒ 640 – 600 + 6x = 7x

⇒ 40 + 6x = 7x

⇒ 7x – 6x = 40

⇒ x = 40

**∴ The required value of x is 40**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**We can also solve this question by **allegation method**.

**Expenditure Savings**

 20% 40%

 **Income**

 28%

 40 - 28 28 - 20

 12 : 8 

 3 : 2

∴ Savings of Radha = 2/5 × 100 = 40%

⇒ sin²θ – 1 + sin²θ – 3sinθ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2sin²θ – 3sinθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 2sin²θ – 2sinθ – sinθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ(sinθ – 1) – 1(sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/1

Now, put the value of θ = 30° 

⇒ √sec30° + tan30° 

⇒ √(2/√3 + 1/√3)

⇒ √(3/√3)

**So, the required value is sqrt[4]{3}**

Now,

(1)/(√{secθ-tanθ)}

Multiplying with the conjugate of √secθ + tanθ 

⇒ 1/√secθ – tanθ × (√secθ + tanθ/√secθ + tanθ)

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/(sec2θ – tan2θ)

⇒ √secθ + tanθ/1

⇒ √sec30° + tan30°

⇒ √(3/√3)

So, the required value is sqrt[4]{3}

questions.question: Vertices A, B,C and D of a quadrilateral ABCD lie on a circle. ∠A is three times ∠C and ∠D is two times ∠B. What is the difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Vertices A, B,C and D of a quadrilateral ABCD lie on a circle

**Concept used:**

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b451a4ac1b8a750eddc69d87e197d4775139ddbcba95f2216003ee0afc66c3f.png] 

⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180° 

⇒ 3θ + θ = 180° 

⇒ 4θ = 180° 

⇒ θ = 45° 

⇒ ∠C = 45° 

Again,

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180° 

⇒ α + 2α = 180° 

⇒ 3α = 180° 

⇒ α = 60° 

⇒ ∠B = 60° 

The value of ∠D = 2α = (2 × 60) = 120° 

The difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C = (120° – 45°)

⇒ 75° 

**∴ The required difference is 75° **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** ⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180° 

⇒ 3θ + θ = 180° 

⇒ θ = 45° 

⇒ ∠C = 45° 

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180° 

⇒ α + 2α = 180° 

⇒ α = 60° 

⇒ ∠B = 60° 

The difference between the measures of ∠D and ∠C = (120° – 45°)

⇒ 75°

questions.question: In an examination, the average score of a student was 67.6. If he would have got 27 more marks in Mathematics, 10 more marks in Computer Science, 18 more marks in History and retained the same marks in other subjects, then his average score would have been 72.6. How many papers were there in the examination?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average score of a student = 67.6

Marks in Mathematics = 27 more

Marks in Computer science = 10 more

Marks in History = 18 more

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let n & X be the number of papers and the total marks.

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

67.6 = X/n

⇒ X = 67.6 n -----(1)

After increasing the marks, the new average

72.6 = (X + 27 + 10 + 18)/n

⇒ 72.6 = (X + 55)/n

⇒ 72.6 = (67.6 n + 55)/n [From equation (1)]

⇒ 67.6n + 55 = 72.6n

⇒ (72.6n – 67.6n) = 55

⇒ 5n = 55

⇒ n = (55/5)

⇒ n = 11

**∴ There were 11 papers in the examination **

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 hours and 16 hours respectively and pipe C can empty the full tank in 24 hours. All three pipes are opened together, but after 4 hours pipe B is closed. In how many hours, the empty tank will be completely filled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe A = 12 hours

Time taken to fill a tank by Pipe B = 16 hours

Time taken to empty a tank by Pipe C = 24 hours

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12, 16 and 24 is 48

Efficiency of A to fill the tank = (48/12) = 4 hours/day

Efficiency of B to fill the tank = (48/16) = 3 hours/day

Efficiency of C to empty the tank = (48/24) = - 2 hours/day

All three pipes opened together for 4 hours = [(4 + 3 – 2) × 4]

⇒ (5 × 4) = 20 unit

Remaining unit = (48 – 20) = 28 unit

Time taken by A and C together = [28/(4 – 2)]

⇒ (28/2) = 14 hours

Now,

Total time is taken to fill the empty tank = (14 + 4) hours

⇒ 18 hours

**∴ The required time is 18 hours**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cadb5a34cf3422fd93dabb3633ce61d1b1af20f3164601db9eea0666a26489b.png] 

Effective efficiency = 5

In 4 hours all three pipes will fill 5 × 4 = 20 units

Now, Remaining 48 - 20 = 28 units will be filled by A and C

So, Total efficiency of A and C = 2

So, time = 28/2 = 14 hours

Total time = 14 + 4 = 18 hours

questions.question: If the 5 - digit number 593ab is divisible by 3, 7 and 11, then what is the value of (a² - b² + ab)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The five-digit number = 593ab

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 3 - **A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

**Divisibility rule of 7 -** If a number is divisible by 7, then the difference between twice the unit digit of the given number and the remaining part of the given number should be a multiple of 7 or it should be equal to 0

**Divisibility rule of 11 -** If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equals 0 or is divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 3, 7, 11 is 231

Let's assume the largest number is 59399.

Now, on dividing 59399 by 231

We get approx 257.13

So, the actual number = 231 × 257 = 59367

So, a = 6 and b = 7

Now,

The value of (a2 – b2 + ab) = (6)² – (7)² + (6 × 7)

⇒ (36 – 49 + 42)

⇒ (78 – 49)

⇒ 29

**∴ The required value is 29**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** The given number is 593ab

We know that, 3, 7, and 11 divide 593ab 

Hence getting the nearest 5-digit number having first 3 digits as 593

⇒ 3 × 7 × 11 = 231

5 digit number will be

⇒ 23100 now we want 5 in 10th thousand place, 

Double of this number will be, 46200, 

We want 593_ _ 

⇒ 46200 + 4620 = 50820 now we want 9 at thousands of places, 

⇒ 50820 + 4620 + 4620 = 60060

subtracting 462 from 60060, 

⇒ 60060 - 462 = 59,598

subtracting 231 from 59,598

⇒ 59367

Hence a = 6 and b = 7

The value of (a² – b² + ab) = (6)² – (7)² + (6 × 7)

⇒ (36 – 49 + 42)

⇒ (78 – 49)

⇒ 29

∴ The required value is 29

questions.question: A fruit merchant bought some bananas. One fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away. He sold two-fifth of the remaining bananas with him at 15% profit and the rest remaining bananas at 10% profit. Find his overall loss or profit percent?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let 100% bananas cost to Rs. 100.

Remaining bananas = 80%

80% bananas cost Rs. 80.

Total profit percentage on them = 2/5 × 15 + 3/5 × 10 = 12%

SP of bananas = 80 × 112/100 = 89.6

Loss = 100 - 89.6 = 10.4

Loss% = (10.4/100) × 100 = 10.4%

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One-fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away.

He sold two-fifth of the remaining bananas with him at a 15% profit 

The remaining bananas at 10% profit. 

**Formula used:**

Loss = SP – CP

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let fruit merchant bought 100 bananas

One fifth of them got rotten and were thrown away = (1/5 of 100)

⇒ (1/5 × 100)

⇒ 20

Now,

He sold two fifth of the bananas with him at 15% profit = (2/5 of 80)

⇒ (2/5 × 80)

⇒ 32 

The remaining bananas at 10% profit = [100 – (20 + 32)]

⇒ (100 – 52) = 48

Now,

Let the CP of each banana be x

Then, CP of 100 banana be 100x

Now,

Total SP = 20x × 0 + 32x(1 + 15/100) + 48x(1 + 10/100)

⇒ 0 + 32x(115/100) + 48x(110/100)

questions.question: A boat covers a round trip journey between two points A and B in a river in T hours. If its speed in still water becomes 2 times, it would take (80)/(161) T hours for the same journey. Find the ratio of its speed in still water to the speed of the river.
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

A boat covers a round trip journey between two points A and B in a river in T hours

**Formula used:**

Downstream = (u + v) km/hr

Upstream = (u – v) km/hr

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of boat in still water be xkm/hr

Speed of stream = y km/hr

Let the distance between them be d 

Downstream = (x + y) km/hr

Upstream = (x – y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ d/(x + y) + d/(x – y) = 161T

⇒ d(x - y + x + y)/ x2 - y2 = 161T

⇒d(2x)/161(x2 - y2) = T ......... (1)

Again,

⇒ d/(2x + y) + d/(2x – y) = 80T

⇒d(2x - y + 2x + y)/(2x)2 - (y)2 = 80T

⇒d(4x) / 80(4x2 - y2) = T ..........(2)

Now equalling both the equations,

⇒d(2x)/161(x2 - y2) = d(4x) / 80(4x2 - y2) 

⇒1/161(x2 - y2) = 2/ 80(4x2 - y2) 

⇒1/(161x2 - 161y2) = 1/(160x2 - 40y2)

⇒160x2 - 40y2 = 161x2 - 161y2

⇒x2 = 121y2

⇒x/y = 11/1

∴ The required ratio is 11 : 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

Let the speed of boat in still water be xkm/hr

Speed of stream = y km/hr

Let the distance between them be d

Upstream = (x – y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ d/(x + y) + d/(x – y) = T

⇒ d(1/x + y) + (1/x – y) = T

⇒ d[(x – y) + (x + y)/(x² – y²)] = T

⇒ d[(2x/(x² – y²) = T

⇒ d/T = x² – y²/2x .....(1)

Again,

⇒ d/(2x + y) + d/(2x – y) = 80T/161

⇒ d(1/2x + y + 1/2x – y) = 80T/161

⇒ d(2x – y+ 2x + y)/4x² – y² = 80T/161

⇒ d(4x/4x² – y²) = 80T/161

⇒ d/T = 80(4x² – y²)/4x × 161 ......(2)

Now, substituting both the equation, we get

d/T = x2 – y2/2x = 80(4x2 – y2)/4x × 161

⇒ x² – y² = 40(4x² – y²)/161

⇒ (161x² – 161y²) = (160x² – 40y²)

⇒ (161x² – 160x²) = (161y² – 40y²)

⇒ x² = 121y²

⇒ x/y = 11/1

**∴ The required ratio is 11 : 1**
